top_strength: Clean, confident pricing delivery — hit the 'pricing is super simple' opener verbatim, gave a clear $101/mover/hour rate with the Saturday $111 tier, and proactively volunteered that weekdays are cheaper, which is genuinely budget-conscious framing the customer didn't ask for.
coaching_note: This was a price-shopper call Zachary had every opening to win and let walk. Don volunteered three destinations, two households of furniture, a second-floor king bed, a wall-mounted TV, and a firm September date — and none of it was probed or priced. The single highest-value fix: run discovery BEFORE quoting. A 2,200 sqft townhome with two households and three stops is a walkthrough candidate, not an off-the-cuff 8-hour two-man quote, and that $1,616 number is almost certainly low enough to blow the estimate-accuracy target on move day. Second, when the customer says 'I'm going to call around,' that is the cue to ask for the booking and get an email out — Zachary had no deposit as a differentiator in hand and still ended with 'give us a call.'
phone_presence_notes: Polite and responsive with a warm close, but purely transactional — no name use, no empathy markers or affirmations, and short clipped replies like 'It's the one I gave you' where a fuller answer was warranted.
